name: @aethelred/wallet-swap-venue-uniswap-v3-cache-redis
description: Redis-backed AllowanceCache implementation for @aethelred/wallet-swap-venue-uniswap-v3. Enables shared allowance-cache state across multi-process / multi-region wallet deployments without forking the venue. Operates against any ioredis- or node-redis-compatible client (RedisLikeClient interface — operators pass their own client instance; this package has zero hard runtime dependencies on a Redis driver).
